map.比特率(bps) = 采样率 × 位深度 × 声道数；文件大小(MB) = 比特: Bit rate (bps) = sample rate × bit depth × channel count; file size (MB) = bit rate × duration (seconds) ÷ 8 ÷ 1024 ÷ 1024; frequency response ceiling = sample rate ÷ 2 (the Nyquist frequency). Downsampling requires a low-pass filter first, with the high end truncated to the new Nyquist frequency; upsampling does not recover lost high frequencies and only interpolates.
map.44.1 kHz / 16bit / 立体声(2ch) / 5 分钟：比特率 =: 44.1 kHz / 16bit / stereo (2ch) / 5 minutes: bit rate = 44100×16×2 = 1,411,200 bps ≈ 1411 kbps; size = 1411200×300/8/1024/1024 ≈ 50.5 MB; frequency response ceiling 22.05 kHz. The same parameters at 48 kHz give about 55.0 MB.
map.为什么频响上限是采样率的一半？: Why is the frequency response ceiling half the sample rate?
map.奈奎斯特采样定理：采样率必须大于信号最高频率的 2 倍才能无失真还原，故可表示的: The Nyquist sampling theorem: the sample rate must be more than twice the highest signal frequency for distortion-free reproduction, so the highest representable frequency = sample rate/2; anything above it aliases.
map.不会。升采样只是插入新采样点（插值），原本被截断的高频信息无法恢复；音质上限由原: No. Upsampling only inserts new samples (interpolation), and the truncated high frequency information cannot be recovered; the quality ceiling is set by the sample rate and bit depth of the original recording.
